checks.text: The known asteroid 2022 UJ185 (MPC orbit, V 23.4) was predicted 67″ to the north of it, moving 47″ an hour toward PA 97°; ours moves 22″ an hour toward PA 140°. Not a certain match: it is 69″ off at the farthest dot, the speeds differ, the directions differ by 43°.
checks.look: On the hours clock in D4, step through its exposures and look 67″ to the north: if a second moving dot runs there, that is 2022 UJ185 and ours is something else; if not, ours may be 2022 UJ185 slightly off its predicted place.
